answer:
I don't know of any such flag. The retrieved documents don't describe an `ollama pull` option for setting the number of parallel layer downloads.

The closest relevant material is the CLI doc, which shows `ollama pull` taking only a model name:

"ollama pull gemma4" [ollama/docs/cli.md]

The API doc for pulling lists only `model`, `insecure`, and `stream` as parameters:

"`model`: name of the model to pull" [ollama/docs/api.md]

It also says the number of files downloaded depends on the manifest, not on a setting:

"The number of files to be downloaded depends on the number of layers specified in the manifest." [ollama/docs/api.md]

So the documents don't show a parallel-download flag, and I can't confirm one exists. Running `ollama pull --help` would show the flags your installed version supports.
